memberdef.name: mbedtls_ssl_cache_get

briefdescription.para: Cache get callback implementation (Thread-safe if MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is enabled)

parameterdescription.para: The SSL cache context to use.
The pointer to the buffer holding the session ID for the session to load.
The length of session_id in bytes.
The address at which to store the session associated with session_id, if present.

simplesect.para: MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_CACHE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND if there is no cache entry with specified session ID found, or any other negative error code for other failures.

memberdef.name: mbedtls_ssl_cache_set

briefdescription.para: Cache set callback implementation (Thread-safe if MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is enabled)

parameterdescription.para: The SSL cache context to use.
The pointer to the buffer holding the session ID associated to session.
The length of session_id in bytes.

simplesect.para: A negative error code on failure.

briefdescription.para: Remove the cache entry by the session ID (Thread-safe if MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is enabled)

parameterdescription.para: The SSL cache context to use.
The pointer to the buffer holding the session ID associated to session.
The length of session_id in bytes.

simplesect.para: 0 on success. This indicates the cache entry for the session with provided ID is removed or does not exist.
A negative error code on failure.
